description: Read a WhatsApp Web chat and return a cloud-AI summary. READ-ONLY: never sends a message. Needs WhatsApp Web already linked on this laptop; opens the contact's chat, reads recent messages, summarizes via cloud Gemini (raw transcript instead when cloud AI is off or fails). The summary is stored under the 'prices' var because Orchestrator.formatSkillResult only renders that var into the result text.
name: WhatsApp read
